title_zh: 骨髓间充质干细胞通过激活miR-129诱导HPV相关宫颈癌上皮间质转化的分子机制研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: HPV-associated cervical cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related death in women worldwide. The role of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) and miR-129 in tumor progression remains unclear. OBJECTIVES: To investigate miR-129 expression and its clinical significance in HPV-associated cervical cancer and to explore whether BMSCs regulate malignant phenotypes through miR-129. METHODS: miR-129 expression was measured by qRT-PCR in 77 cervical cancer and 30 normal cervical tissues. Associations with clinicopathological features and overall survival (OS) were analyzed. Diagnostic value was assessed by ROC curve. Rat BMSCs were co-cultured with SiHa and HeLa cells. Following miR-129 overexpression or knockdown, cell proliferation (CCK-8, colony formation), invasion (Transwell) and expression of E-cadherin, N-cadherin and MRP1 (Western blot) were examined. RESULTS: miR-129 expression was significantly higher in cervical cancer tissues than in normal controls (3.24±0.56 vs. High miR-129 expression correlated with tumor size ≥3 cm (P=0.009), FIGO stage III-IV (P=0.0034) and lymph node metastasis (P=0.038). High expression was associated with shorter OS (median: 28.4 vs. 46.2 months; HR=2.944, 95%CI:1.484-5.842, P=0.002). The AUC was 0.788 (95%CI:0.693-0.884), with a cut-off of 1.85 (sensitivity:76.9%, specificity:70.4%). BMSC co-culture upregulated miR-129 expression (SiHa: 3.52±0.42 vs. miR-129 overexpression promoted proliferation, colony formation and invasion, while knockdown suppressed these phenotypes. Overexpression of miR-129 reduced E-cadherin (0.42±0.05 vs. 1.00±0.08, P<0.01) and increased N-cadherin (2.85±0.22 vs. 1.00±0.10, P<0.01) and MRP1 (2.46±0.18 vs. Knockdown of miR-129 partially reversed BMSC-induced changes in these proteins. CONCLUSION: miR-129 is significantly upregulated in HPV-associated cervical cancer and shows potential as a diagnostic and prognostic biomarker. BMSCs upregulate miR-129 in cervical cancer cells and miR-129 modulates proliferation, invasion, EMT marker expression and MRP1 expression. These findings suggest that the BMSCs/miR-129 axis may contribute to cervical cancer progression, but further in-vivo and mechanistic studies are needed.

title: Prevalence and distribution of high-risk Human Papillomavirus Genotypes in Cervical cancer tissue biopsies at Bugando Medical Centre, Northwestern Tanzania
abstract: Abstract Background Cervical cancer remains a major public health problem in sub-Saharan Africa, where the distribution of high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) genotypes varies geographically. Data on hrHPV genotypes in cervical cancer tissue from northwestern Tanzania are limited. This study determined the prevalence and distribution of hrHPV genotypes in fresh cervical cancer tissue biopsies at Bugando Medical Centre, Mwanza, Tanzania. Methods We conducted a hospital-based study among 309 women with histologically confirmed cervical cancer between January 2024 and January 2025. We tested fresh cervical tissue biopsies for hrHPV DNA using the AnyplexTM II HPV28 real-time PCR assay. We analysed clinical, demographic, and histopathological characteristics using chi-square and logistic regression. Genotype-level analyses accounted for clustering of multiple detections within women. Results We detected hrHPV DNA in 277/309 (89.6%) women. Among hrHPV-positive women, 69.0% had multiple-genotype infections. Of 581 genotype detections, HPV16 was most frequent (36.7%), followed by HPV18 (21.9%), HPV45 (7.2%), HPV33 (6.5%), HPV35 (6.0%), HPV31 (5.7%) and HPV59 (5.5%). HrHPV positivity was higher in squamous cell carcinoma than adenocarcinoma (91.7% vs 83.7%; p = 0.044), but histological subtype was not independently associated with hrHPV positivity. Among women with known HIV status, HIV-positive status was associated with higher odds of HPV16/18 detection compared with other hrHPV genotypes (OR 1.50, 95% CI 1.09–2.05; p = 0.013).

title: A Community Engaged Feasibility Study of High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Self-Sampling for Cervical Cancer Screening in Sexual and Gender Minority People
abstract: Background and Objectives: We investigated the acceptability and feasibility of at-home self-sampling cervical cancer screening (CCS) for high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) in sexual and gender minority (SGM) Kentuckians. Methods: We conducted a descriptive qualitative study using virtual interviews to investigate socioecological factors influencing CCS and the feasibility and acceptability of at-home hrHPV self-sampling for primary CCS. Criterion and snowball sampling were used. Data were analyzed using a hybrid inductive-deductive thematic approach and team member consensus to identify salient themes. Results: Nineteen participants completed hrHPV self-sampling and qualitative interviews in 2022–2023. The 6 overarching themes identified were cervical cancer screening perceptions, prior negative healthcare experiences, desirability of hrHPV self-sampling, completing hrHPV self-sampling, concerns about hrHPV self-sampling, and reasons for study participation. Conclusion: At-home hrHPV self-sampling is a promising intervention to increase CCS in SGM people. Individuals should be reassured that self-sampling is an effective method for primary CCS and that they are likely to be able to collect a sample that will yield accurate results. To maximize the possibility of CCS completion by SGM individuals, healthcare providers and healthcare environments must be affirming, culturally competent, and informed partners throughout the CCS process.

analysis.study_design_and_population: A descriptive qualitative study was conducted using virtual interviews with 19 participants in 2022–2023 to explore socioecological factors influencing cervical cancer screening and the feasibility of hrHPV self-sampling in SGM individuals.
analysis.methods: Criterion and snowball sampling were used to recruit participants, and data were analyzed using a hybrid inductive-deductive thematic approach with team member consensus to identify salient themes.
analysis.main_results: Six overarching themes were identified: cervical cancer screening perceptions, prior negative healthcare experiences, desirability of hrHPV self-sampling, completing hrHPV self-sampling, concerns about hrHPV self-sampling, and reasons for study participation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that at-home hrHPV self-sampling is a promising intervention to increase cervical cancer screening in SGM people, highlighting the importance of culturally competent healthcare environments.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that hrHPV self-sampling could be a valuable tool for improving cervical cancer screening rates among SGM individuals, potentially contributing to more equitable healthcare access.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its qualitative design and small sample size, but the evidence is strong due to the use of team member consensus and thematic analysis to identify salient themes.

analysis.summary_en: This study explored the acceptability and feasibility of at-home self-sampling for high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) cervical cancer screening among sexual and gender minority (SGM) individuals in Kentucky. Using virtual interviews with 19 participants, the research identified six key themes related to perceptions of cervical cancer screening, past negative healthcare experiences, and the desirability and concerns of hrHPV self-sampling. The authors concluded that hrHPV self-sampling is a promising intervention to increase screening rates in SGM populations, emphasizing the need for culturally competent healthcare environments. The study's qualitative design and small sample size limit its generalizability, but the thematic analysis and team consensus provide robust insights into the feasibility of this approach. These findings could inform future efforts to improve cervical cancer screening access for marginalized groups.

abstract_zh: 背景和目标:我们调查了肯塔基州性少数群体 (SGM) 家庭自我采样 宫颈癌 筛查 (CCS) 对高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (hrHPV) 的可接受性和可行性。方法:我们利用虚拟访谈进行了一项描述性定性研究,以调查影响 CCS 的社会生态因素以及家庭 hrHPV 自我采样用于原发性 CCS 的可行性和可接受性。使用标准抽样和滚雪球抽样。使用混合归纳演绎主题方法和团队成员共识来分析数据,以确定显着主题。结果:19 名参与者在 2022-2023 年完成了 hrHPV 自我采样和定性访谈。确定的 6 个首要主题是 宫颈癌 筛查认知、既往负面医疗经历、hrHPV 自我采样的可取性、完成 hrHPV 自我采样、对 hrHPV 自我采样的担忧以及参与研究的原因。结论:家庭 hrHPV 自我采样是一种有前景的干预措施,可增加 SGM 人群的 CCS。应让个人放心,自我取样是主要 CCS 的有效方法,并且他们很可能能够收集产生准确结果的样本。为了最大限度地提高 SGM 个人完成 CCS 的可能性,医疗保健提供者和医疗保健环境必须在整个 CCS 过程中成为肯定的、具有文化能力和知情的合作伙伴。

title: The dentist as sentinel: HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer, the limits of the oral examination, vaccine advocacy and diagnostic delay in United States men — an integrated narrative and scoping review with a National Interest perspective
abstract: Oropharyngeal cancer caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) has become the most common HPV-attributable cancer in the United States, and its burden falls disproportionately on men. Because dentists examine the mouth and pharynx of a large share of the population at regular intervals, the dental visit is a strategic but underused point of contact for both early recognition and vaccine promotion. This integrated review combines a narrative synthesis of the epidemiology, clinical presentation, diagnostic pathway and drivers of delay of HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer with a scoping map of studies on dental professionals' knowledge, attitudes and practices regarding HPV vaccination and of policy initiatives that allow vaccine promotion or administration in dental settings. PubMed-indexed literature and official United States sources (CDC, NCHS, American Cancer Society, FDA, HHS and state legislatures) were examined up to October 2026. Incidence among men rose 2.7% per year between 2001 and 2017, regional-stage disease predominated, and men carry an oral HPV prevalence of 11.5% against 3.2% in women. The primary tumour is frequently invisible on routine inspection, and a painless neck mass is the most common first sign. Up-to-date adolescent HPV vaccination reached 63.4% in 2025, without improvement for four consecutive years, while 86.9% of children and 66.7% of adults report a dental visit in the past year. Fewer than one-third of surveyed dentists discuss the vaccine, yet more than half say they would administer it if allowed. A sentinel framework for screening, referral and vaccine advocacy is proposed, together with education priorities for the dental workforce, and the national interest of the problem is set out. The study's limitations and suggestions for future research are discussed.
journal: South Florida Journal of Environmental and Animal Science

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the rising burden of HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer in the United States, particularly among men, and highlights the potential of dentists as sentinels for early detection and vaccine promotion. The review synthesizes epidemiological data, clinical features, and diagnostic challenges of HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer, alongside a scoping analysis of dental professionals' knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding HPV vaccination. It notes that while HPV vaccination rates among adolescents have stagnated, dental visits remain common, suggesting an opportunity for integrating vaccine advocacy into routine dental care. The review proposes a framework for dental professionals to engage in screening, referral, and vaccine promotion, emphasizing the need for education and policy changes to support this role. Despite the potential, the study finds that fewer than one-third of dentists discuss HPV vaccination, though more than half express willingness to administer it if permitted. The review concludes with a call for further research and action to address the gaps in HPV-related cancer prevention and management.

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 2001 年至 2017 年间,男性中的 发病率 每年上升 2.7%,区域期疾病占主导地位,男性口腔 HPV 发病率 携带率为 11.5%,而女性为 3.2%。原发肿瘤在常规检查中通常是看不见的,无痛性颈部肿块是最常见的首发症状。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 不到三分之一的受访牙医讨论了 疫苗,但超过一半的人表示,如果允许,他们会实施该治疗。最新的青少年HPV 疫苗接种在2025年达到63.4%,连续四年没有改善,而86.9%的儿童和66.7%的成人报告在过去一年曾去看牙医。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 提出了筛查、转诊和 疫苗 倡导的哨兵框架,以及牙科劳动力的教育优先事项,并阐述了该问题的国家利益。讨论了该研究的局限性以及对未来研究的建议。

title: Covalent Ligands that Target the Human Papillomavirus E6 Oncoprotein.
abstract: The high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) early protein 6 (E6) viral oncoprotein is a key player in HPV-mediated cancers and is the major driver of cervical, anal, and a substantial portion of head and neck cancers. HPV E6 recruits the cellular ubiquitin E3-ligase E6-associated protein (E6AP), also termed UBE3A, and this E6/E6AP complex in turn recruits the tumor suppressor p53, resulting in the ubiquitin-mediated degradation of p53. The cysteine-rich E6 protein presents an attractive target for chemical intervention through covalent, cysteine-reactive chemistries. While previous studies have uncovered peptidic covalent inhibitors of E6, we sought to determine whether we could identify nonpeptidic functional binders. We screened a library of cysteine-reactive covalent ligands and identified a pyrazoline hit, EN218, bearing a chloroacetamide cysteine-reactive warhead. Evaluation of pyrazoline analogs led to the development of an improved molecule, (S)-WX48A, that stereoselectively reacted with C58 on E6 to inhibit E6-mediated p53 ubiquitination. While this molecule is still in an early stage and requires further medicinal chemistry optimization to exert on-target cellular activity, our study demonstrates that E6 can be directly and stereoselectively targeted with a covalent nonpeptidic small-molecule and provides a foundation for developing more drug-like E6 inhibitors for HPV therapy.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the need for nonpeptidic functional binders targeting the HPV E6 oncoprotein, which is a key driver of several HPV-associated cancers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved screening a library of cysteine-reactive covalent ligands to identify potential inhibitors of the HPV E6 oncoprotein, focusing on its role in cancer progression.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed a library of cysteine-reactive covalent ligands to screen for functional binders, with a focus on the E6 protein's interaction with E6AP and its effect on p53 ubiquitination.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide a foundation for the development of new therapeutic agents targeting HPV E6, which could lead to improved treatments for HPV-associated cancers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is still in an early stage and requires further medicinal chemistry optimization to achieve on-target cellular activity, indicating moderate confidence in the current findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study focuses on the development of covalent ligands targeting the human papillomavirus (HPV) E6 oncoprotein, a key driver of several HPV-associated cancers. The research aimed to identify nonpeptidic functional binders, as previous studies had explored peptidic inhibitors. A library of cysteine-reactive covalent ligands was screened, leading to the identification of a pyrazoline hit, EN218, and the subsequent development of (S)-WX48A, which stereoselectively binds to C58 on E6 to inhibit p53 ubiquitination. The findings suggest a novel approach for creating drug-like E6 inhibitors, potentially advancing HPV therapy. However, the molecule is still in an early stage and requires further optimization to achieve on-target cellular activity, limiting the current evidence strength to moderate.

abstract_zh: 高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 早期蛋白 6 (E6) 病毒癌蛋白是 HPV 介导的癌症的关键参与者,也是宫颈癌、肛门癌和大部分头颈癌的主要驱动因素。HPV E6 招募细胞泛素 E3 连接酶 E6 相关蛋白 (E6AP),也称为 UBE3A,而该 E6/E6AP 复合物反过来又招募肿瘤抑制因子 p53,导致泛素介导的 p53 降解。The cysteine-rich E6 protein presents an attractive target for chemical intervention through covalent,cysteine-reactive chemistries.虽然之前的研究已经发现了 E6 的肽共价抑制剂,但我们试图确定是否可以识别非肽功能结合剂。我们筛选了半胱氨酸反应性共价配体库,并鉴定了吡唑啉命中物EN218,其带有氯乙酰胺半胱氨酸反应性弹头。对吡唑啉类似物的评估导致了改进分子 (S)-WX48A 的开发,该分子与 E6 上的 C58 立体选择性反应,抑制 E6 介导的 p53 泛素化。虽然该分子仍处于早期阶段,需要进一步的药物化学优化以发挥靶向细胞活性,但我们的研究表明,E6 可以直接立体选择性地靶向共价非肽小分子,并为开发更多用于 HPV 治疗的药物样 E6 抑制剂奠定了基础。

title: Natural history of oral human papillomavirus among participants recruited through MSM-focused services in southwestern Kenya: an 18-month prospective cohort study
abstract: Oral human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA is associated with a subset of oropharyngeal cancers. We characterised oral HPV prevalence, incidence, same-type persistence, and first non-detection, and examined associated factors among participants recruited through MSM-focused services in Kenya. Between July and December 2023, we enrolled 398 adults through two key-population clinics in Kisumu County, Kenya, with equal numbers by HIV status. Oral-rinse specimens were collected at baseline and at months 6, 12, and 18 and tested for HPV DNA by PCR with targeted high-risk genotyping. Among 398 participants, oral HPV DNA prevalence was 7·8% at baseline, increased to 21·0% at month 12, and declined to 14·9% at month 18. The reported overall incidence rate was 82·0 per 1,000 person-months; there was no statistical evidence of a difference by HIV status (IRR 1·01, 95% CI 0·74–1·39), although the confidence interval was imprecise. Same-type high-risk HPV was detected at consecutive visits in 18 participants (4·5% of the cohort), corresponding to 35 participant-genotype combinations and 38 consecutive-interval persistence events, and more than half of genotype detections were absent at the next scheduled six-month visit. Receptive oral sex was associated with prevalent detection (aOR 2·78, 95% CI 1·17–6·42) and same-type persistence (aOR 4·14, 95% CI 1·48–11·87). Several frequently detected high-risk genotypes are included in the 9-valent HPV vaccine, whereas other detected high-risk types are not vaccine antigens. These findings motivate evaluation of inclusive HPV-vaccination strategies alongside HIV and sexual-health services, but do not alone establish vaccine effectiveness or justify a policy change.

Oral-rinse specimens were collected at baseline and at months 6, 12, and 18 and tested for HPV DNA by PCR with targeted high-risk genotyping. title: Clinician Training, Text Messages, and Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Among Children Aged 10 to 12 Years
abstract: Importance Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination rates among adolescents remain below recommendations. Objective To evaluate the effectiveness of clinician communication training and parent-targeted text messages at increasing HPV vaccination among children aged 11 to 12 years. Design, Setting, and Participants This doubly randomized, 2-level nested clinical trial was conducted from February 2022 to September 2024 among clinicians at 30 pediatric primary care clinics in Florida, children aged 10 to 12 years who had not received any of the 3 adolescent HPV vaccines, and their parents. Interventions occurred for 1 year, and vaccine records were collected for 2 years. Interventions Clinics were randomized 1:1:1 to 3 training groups: (1) the bundled approach, which presents the HPV vaccine in the middle of 2 other recommended vaccines; (2) the focused approach, which emphasizes cancer prevention; and (3) deferred, which offered clinicians the opportunity to participate in the focused training after the trial concluded. Clinicians in the first 2 groups completed a 1-hour communication training and a 5-minute booster session. Patients within clinics were randomized 1:1:1 to 3 text message groups, aligned with the communication strategies: (1) bundled, (2) focused, and (3) no text messages. Parents were sent text messages at the start of the study or prior to their child’s 11th birthday as well as prior to appointments. Main Outcomes and Measures Primary outcomes were HPV vaccine initiation (receipt of first dose) and completion (receipt of second dose). Analyses accounted for clinic-level clustering. Effects were analyzed as randomized and text messages as received. Results At baseline, 59 clinicians (44 [75%] female; 12 [20%] Asian, 21 [36%] Hispanic, and 21 [36%] non-Hispanic White) within 30 randomized clinics were included, with 17 randomized to the focused group, 21 to the bundled group, and 21 to the deferred group. A total of 7234 children were aged 10 (3576 [49%]), 11 (2617 [36%]), and 12 (1041 [14%]) years at study start (1673 [23%] Hispanic, 1001 [14%] non-Hispanic Black, and 1210 [17%] non-Hispanic White). A total of 28 clinics (93%), 50 clinicians (85%), and 6498 children (90%) completed the 2-year follow-up. The mean pre-post clinic-level difference for HPV vaccine initiation was 28.2 (95% CI, 25.3-31.1) percentage points and for completion was 16.1 (95% CI, 13.3-18.9) percentage points. Risk ratios for clinician training and text messaging did not differ between groups for initiation or completion. Among patients whose parents received text messages vs not, the risk ratio for initiation was 1.17 (95% CI, 1.08-1.26) and for completion was 1.29 (95% CI, 1.06-1.56). Conclusions and Relevance In this study of Florida children aged 10 to 12 years, clinic-level HPV vaccination increased over time. No differences in HPV vaccination by random assignment of clinician training or text messages were detected. When received, text messages were associated with higher HPV vaccination. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05006833

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of clinician communication training and parent-targeted text messages at increasing HPV vaccination among children aged 11 to 12 years. Importance was placed on the fact that HPV vaccination rates among adolescents remain below recommendations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a doubly randomized, 2-level nested clinical trial conducted from February 2022 to September 2024 among clinicians at 30 pediatric primary care clinics in Florida, children aged 10 to 12 years who had not received any of the 3 adolescent HPV vaccines, and their parents.
analysis.methods: Clinicians in the first 2 groups completed a 1-hour communication training and a 5-minute booster session. Patients within clinics were randomized 1:1:1 to 3 text message groups, aligned with the communication strategies: (1) bundled, (2) focused, and (3) no text messages. Analyses accounted for clinic-level clustering.
analysis.main_results: At baseline, 59 clinicians were included, with 17 randomized to the focused group, 21 to the bundled group, and 21 to the deferred group. The mean pre-post clinic-level difference for HPV vaccine initiation was 28.2 (95% CI, 25.3-31.1) percentage points and for completion was 16.1 (95% CI, 13.3-18.9) percentage points. Risk ratios for clinician training and text messaging did not differ between groups for initiation or completion. Among patients whose parents received text messages vs not, the risk ratio for initiation was 1.17 (95% CI, 1.08-1.26) and for completion was 1.29 (95% CI, 1.06-1.56).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that clinic-level HPV vaccination increased over time, but no differences in HPV vaccination by random assignment of clinician training or text messages were detected. When received, text messages were associated with higher HPV vaccination.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that parent-targeted text messages may be a useful tool to increase HPV vaccination rates among children aged 10 to 12 years, which could inform future public health strategies for improving vaccination coverage.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study had a high confidence level as it was a randomized trial with a large sample size, but the lack of differences in vaccination rates by clinician training or text message groups may limit the strength of the evidence for these interventions.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the effectiveness of clinician communication training and parent-targeted text messages in increasing HPV vaccination rates among children aged 10 to 12 years. Conducted in Florida, it involved 30 pediatric clinics and a large sample of children and parents. Clinicians were randomized into three training groups, while children were randomized into three text message groups. The results showed that clinic-level HPV vaccination increased over time, but no differences were detected between the training groups. Text messages were associated with higher vaccination rates. The study's design and large sample size support high confidence, though the lack of significant differences in the training groups may limit the strength of the evidence for those interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估临床医生沟通培训和针对家长的短信对增加 11 至 12 岁儿童 HPV 疫苗接种 的有效性。值得注意的是,青少年中的 HPV 疫苗接种 率仍然低于建议值。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项双重随机、二级巢式临床试验,于 2022 年 2 月至 2024 年 9 月在佛罗里达州 30 个儿科初级保健诊所的临床医生、未接受过 3 种青少年 HPV 疫苗 中任何一种的 10 至 12 岁儿童及其父母中进行。
elements_zh.methods: 前两组临床医生完成了 1 小时的沟通培训和 5 分钟的强化课程。诊所内的患者按照 1:1:1 的比例随机分为 3 个短信组,并采用以下沟通策略:(1) 捆绑、(2) 重点突出、(3) 无短信。分析考虑了临床层面的聚类。
elements_zh.main_results: At baseline, 59 clinicians were included, with 17 randomized to the focused group, 21 to the bundled group, and 21 to the deferred group. The mean pre-post clinic-level difference for HPV vaccine initiation was 28.2 (95% CI, 25.3-31.1) percentage points and for completion was 16.1 (95% CI, 13.3-18.9) percentage points. Risk ratios for clinician training and text messaging did not differ between groups for initiation or completion. Among patients whose parents received text messages vs not, the risk ratio for initiation was 1.17 (95% CI, 1.08-1.26) and for completion was 1.29 (95% CI, 1.06-1.56).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,临床水平 HPV 疫苗接种 随着时间的推移而增加,但通过临床医生培训或短信的随机分配,未检测到 HPV 疫苗接种 的差异。收到后,短信与较高的 HPV 疫苗接种 相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对家长的短信可能是提高 10 至 12 岁儿童 HPV 疫苗接种 感染率的有用工具,这可以为未来提高 疫苗接种 覆盖率的公共卫生策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究具有较高的置信度,因为它是一项样本量较大的随机试验,但临床医生培训或短信组的 疫苗接种 率缺乏差异可能会限制这些干预措施的证据强度。

title: Agreement and comparative performance of the MobiLab rapid oncoprotein E6/E7 antigen test and Cobas 4800 high-risk human papillomavirus deoxyribonucleic acid test for cervical cancer screening in a low-resource setting: a cross-sectional study
abstract: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) accounts for approximately 97–99% of cervical cancer cases worldwide. Molecular assays that detect viral deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) are considered the gold standard for screening and early detection but remain inaccessible in many low-resource settings because of their cost and technical requirements. The MobiLab rapid oncoprotein E6/E7 antigen test offers a potential point-of-care alternative for identifying active oncogene expression associated with malignant transformation. However, its agreement with standard DNA-based platforms has not been fully established. This study aimed to evaluate the agreement and performance of the MobiLab rapid oncoprotein E6/E7 antigen test and polymerase chain reaction (PCR) for DNA testing, using a Cobas 4800 as the reference standard in a low-resource setting. This cross-sectional study was conducted between February and July 2024 and included women who underwent cervical cancer screening at Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital. In total, 257 women aged 30 years and older were randomly selected for this study. A cervical swab was obtained from all participants by healthcare providers for HR-HPV PCR DNA testing, followed by the collection of a cervical sample from all participants using the Delphi vaginal sampler for the MobiLab rapid oncoprotein E6/E7 antigen test. The Cobas 4800 assay is a qualitative, real-time PCR test that amplifies target sequences in the L1 region of the HR-HPV genome. It detects 14 HR-HPV types, including 16, 18, and 12 other oncogenic types (31, 33, 35, 39, 45, 51, 52, 56, 58, 59, 66, and 68). To achieve the objective of the study, we calculated the agreement metrics for a comparative analysis, including overall, positive, and negative agreement, as well as Cohen’s kappa (κ) coefficient. The sensitivity, specificity, predictive values, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) were also determined. Data on clinical characteristics were collected and analysed. All the statistical tests were two-tailed, and p < 0.05 was considered to indicate statistical significance. The overall positivity rate of the MobiLab rapid oncoprotein E6/E7 antigen test was 58.0% (149/257). Cross-tabulation of the MobiLab rapid oncoprotein E6/E7 antigen test and the Cobas 4800 HR-HPV DNA assay showed near-perfect agreement, with 148 of 149 positive results and 107 of 108 negative results classified similarly by both assays. The overall agreement was 99.22%, with positive and negative agreement rates of 99.33% and 99.07%, respectively. The two assays showed near-perfect agreement (Cohen’s κ = 0.992; 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.96–1.00; p < 0.001). Comparative performance analysis yielded a sensitivity of 99.33% (95% CI: 96.32–99.98%), a specificity of 99.07% (95% CI: 94.95–99.98%), a positive predictive value of 99.33% (95% CI: 95.46–99.90%), a negative predictive value of 99.07% (95% CI: 93.82–99.87%), and an AUC of 0.992 (95% CI: 0.979–1.000). The results of the MobiLab rapid oncoprotein E6/E7 antigen test agreed with those of the Cobas 4800 HR-HPV DNA assay. Further studies incorporating cytological, colposcopic, and histopathological endpoints are needed to establish the clinical validity and determine the potential role of the MobiLab rapid oncoprotein E6/E7 antigen test in HPV screening programs in resource-limited settings.

title: HPV16/18 Genotype and Histologic High-Grade Disease in Women with ASC-H Cytology: A Systematic Review of Genotype-Stratified Outcomes
abstract: Background/Objectives: Human papillomavirus (HPV) genotyping may stratify histologic risk among women with atypical squamous cells that cannot exclude high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (ASC-H). We evaluated genotype-specific high-grade outcomes. Methods: PubMed and Europe PMC were searched on 1 October 2026 and updated on 7 October 2026. Two reviewers independently screened, extracted, and appraised studies in accordance with PRISMA 2020. Eligible English language studies provided ASC-H-specific histologic outcomes for HPV16/18-defined and comparator groups. Risk of bias was appraised with an adapted QUADAS-2 framework (the protocol-specified Joanna Briggs Institute prevalence checklist is reported in an appendix), and certainty was rated with GRADE. An exploratory restricted meta-analysis compared HPV16/18 with other high-risk HPV (hrHPV) for CIN2+/HSIL+ using random effects and modified Hartung–Knapp confidence intervals. Results: Sixteen studies in 17 reports were included; six contributed 1655 women to the restricted comparison. The pooled risk ratio was 1.19 (95% confidence interval, 0.94–1.49), with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 64.9%) and a prediction interval of 0.70–2.01. The results varied with study selection and genotype definition. In four studies with at least 30 hrHPV-negative women, high-grade outcomes occurred in 6.8–18.4%, and HPV-negative carcinomas were reported. Leave-one-out, screening context, and verification-restricted analyses did not show a consistent difference (histology in all participants: RR 1.01, 0.63–1.62). Incomplete verification, confounding by age and screening context, heterogeneous assays and populations, and inaccessible reports limited confidence; certainty was very low for both outcomes. Conclusions: A modest relative difference between HPV16/18 and other hrHPV types cannot be excluded, but the pooled evidence does not demonstrate a consistent incremental risk difference. Other hrHPV types and negative hrHPV results do not exclude high-grade disease. These findings are consistent with current guidance for colposcopic evaluation of all ASC-H without genotype-based deferral.

abstract_zh: 背景/目标:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 基因分型可以对患有非典型鳞状细胞的女性进行组织学风险分层,但不能排除高级鳞状上皮内病变 (ASC-H)。我们评估了基因型特异性的高等级结果。方法:PubMed 和 Europe PMC 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日检索,并于 2026 年 10 月 7 日更新。两名评审员根据 PRISMA 2020 独立筛选、提取和评估研究。符合条件的英语语言研究为 HPV16/18 定义组和比较组提供了 ASC-H 特异性组织学结果。使用改编的 QUADAS-2 框架评估偏倚风险(附录中报告了协议指定的 Joanna Briggs Institute 患病率 检查表),并使用 GRADE 评估确定性。一项探索性限制性荟萃分析使用随机效应和修正的 Hartung-Knapp 置信区间对 HPV16/18 与其他 高危型HPV (hrHPV) 的 CIN2+/HSIL+ 进行比较。结果:纳入 17 份报告中的 16 项研究;六家公司将 1655 名女性纳入了有限比较。合并风险比为 1.19(95% 置信区间,0.94-1.49),具有显着异质性(I2 = 64.9%),预测区间为 0.70-2.01。结果因研究选择和基因型定义而异。在对至少 30 名 hrHPV 阴性女性进行的四项研究中,6.8-18.4% 的患者获得了高级别结果,并且报告了 HPV 阴性癌症。留一法、筛查背景和验证限制分析没有显示出一致的差异(所有参与者的组织学:RR 1.01、0.63-1.62)。验证不完整、年龄和筛查背景的混淆、异质测定和人群以及难以获取的报告限制了可信度;这两种结果的确定性都非常低。结论:不能排除 HPV16/18 与其他 hrHPV 类型之间存在适度的相对差异,但汇总的证据并未证明存在一致的增量风险差异。其他 hrHPV 类型和 hrHPV 结果阴性并不能排除重度疾病。这些发现与目前对所有 ASC-H 进行阴道镜评估的指南一致,无需基于基因型的延期。

title: Diagnostic pitfalls leading to delayed diagnosis of human papillomavirus (HPV)–independent cervical malignancies in the era of HPV-based screening: clinicopathologic analysis of diagnostic pathways
abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV)–independent cervical malignancies (HPV-IDCM) are a rare but clinically important subset that may escape detection by HPV-based screening. This study investigated diagnostic pitfalls contributing to delayed HPV-IDCM diagnosis and assessed the role of cervical cytology in the diagnostic pathway. Methods: This multicenter retrospective case series was conducted as a policy research project of the Korean Society for Cytopathology. Patients with HPV-IDCM and repeated abnormal cytologic findings before definitive histologic diagnosis were identified. Clinical, cytologic, histologic, and HPV test results were reviewed to identify factors associated with diagnostic delay. Results: Four patients were included, with a median age of 74 years (range, 62 to 79 years). Histologic diagnoses comprised three HPV-independent gastric-type adenocarcinomas and one HPV-independent squamous cell carcinoma. The median interval from the first abnormal cytologic finding to definitive diagnosis was 18.5 months (range, 11 to 30 months). Before diagnosis, all patients underwent a median of 3.5 cytologic examinations (range, 3 to 5). Associated factors included repeatedly negative HPV test results (3/4), nondiagnostic biopsy or conization (2/4), delayed tissue evaluation despite persistent cytologic abnormalities (1/4), deeply located endocervical lesions (3/4), and a concurrent HPV-associated squamous lesion (1/4). Re-review identified atypical or malignant cells in all cases, indicating that the delay did not result from failure of cytologic detection. Conclusions: HPV-IDCM remain vulnerable to delayed diagnosis in the era of HPV-based screening. Persistent abnormal cytologic findings should not be dismissed solely because HPV test results are negative. Careful correlation of cytologic, clinical, and histologic findings remains essential for timely HPV-IDCM detection.

abstract_zh: 背景:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 独立宫颈恶性肿瘤 (HPV-IDCM) 是一种罕见但具有临床重要意义的亚型,可能会逃避基于 HPV 的筛查的检测。本研究调查了导致 HPV-IDCM 诊断 延迟的诊断陷阱,并评估了宫颈细胞学在诊断途径中的作用。方法:这个多中心回顾性病例系列是作为韩国细胞病理学会的政策研究项目进行的。在确定明确的组织学 诊断 之前,患有 HPV-IDCM 且重复出现异常细胞学结果的患者。对临床、细胞学、组织学和 HPV 检测结果进行审查,以确定与诊断延迟相关的因素。结果:纳入 4 名患者,中位年龄 74 岁(范围 62 至 79 岁)。组织学诊断包括三种不依赖 HPV 的胃型腺癌和一种不依赖 HPV 的鳞状细胞癌。从第一次异常细胞学发现到最终 诊断 的中位间隔为 18.5 个月(范围为 11 至 30 个月)。在诊断之前,所有患者平均接受了3.5次细胞学检查(范围为3至5次)。相关因素包括 HPV 检测结果反复呈阴性 (3/4)、非诊断性活检或锥切术 (2/4)、尽管持续细胞学异常却延迟组织评估 (1/4)、深部宫颈内膜病变 (3/4) 以及并发 HPV 相关鳞状病变 (1/4)。重新审查在所有病例中均发现了非典型或恶性细胞,表明延迟并非由于细胞学检测失败造成的。结论:在基于 HPV 的筛查时代,HPV-IDCM 仍然容易受到延迟的 诊断 的影响。持续存在的异常细胞学检查结果不应仅仅因为 HPV 检测结果呈阴性而被忽视。细胞学、临床和组织学结果的仔细关联对于及时检测 HPV-IDCM 仍然至关重要。

title: Human Papillomavirus Genotype Distribution and Co-Infection Patterns in Clinically Selected Iraqi Women: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Background: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) genotypes is the principal etiological factor in cervical carcinogenesis. However, HPV genotype distribution and co-infection patterns differ across populations and clinical settings. The present study aimed to characterize HPV genotypes and co-infection patterns among clinically selected Iraqi women with suspected HPV-associated disease. Methods: In this cross-sectional study, 100 clinically selected women attending clinics in Ramadi and Baghdad, Iraq (December 2025–July 2026), each contributed one specimen, collected by swab or superficial lesion scraping from a cervical, vulval, anal, or perianal site based on clinical assessment. HPV genotyping was performed by polymerase chain reaction followed by microarray hybridization, targeting 35 HPV genotypes. Results: HPV DNA was detected in 65 of 100 women (65.0%; 95% confidence interval, 55.3–73.6%). Of these, 48 had low-risk (LR)-only, 9 high-risk/potentially high-risk (HR/PHR)-only, and 8 mixed LR/HR/PHR infections. HPV-6 and HPV-11 were the most frequently detected genotypes (36 and 27 of 88 genotype detections, respectively), and multiple-genotype infections were identified in 20 women. Conclusions: HPV-6 and HPV-11 predominated in this clinically selected cohort, although HR/PHR and multiple-genotype infections were also identified. These preliminary, descriptive data highlight the need for larger, more representative studies of HPV genotype distribution in Iraq.

title: Baseline erythrocyte folate and outcomes of low grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia in a prospective cohort
abstract: Objective To examine the association between baseline erythrocyte folate and reversal, persistence, and progression of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 1 (CIN1). Methods This community-based prospective cohort included 564 Chinese women with CIN1, with follow-up assessments at 6, 12, and 24 months. Baseline erythrocyte folate was measured by chemiluminescence immunoassay. Histological outcomes were classified as reversal, persistence, or progression to CIN2 or worse (CIN2+); persistence and progression formed a composite adverse outcome. Analyses included Cox regression, restricted cubic splines, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves. Exploratory experiments assessed proliferation and apoptosis in C33A and CaSki cervical cancer cells. Results Among the 453 women assessed at 24 months, 342 (75.5%) had reversal, 58 (12.8%) had persistence, and 53 (11.7%) had progression to CIN2+. Lower baseline erythrocyte folate was associated with the composite adverse outcome in the reported adjusted model (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] = 2.42, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.62–3.61). No statistically significant nonlinearity was detected for this outcome at 6 or 12 months ( p = 0.655 and p = 0.127), whereas an L-shaped association was observed at 24 months (P for nonlinearity = 0.005). At 24 months, the area under the ROC curve (AUC) for folate was 0.703 (95% CI: 0.647–0.760) overall and 0.742 (95% CI: 0.646–0.837) within the high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV)-positive subgroup. Higher nominal folate concentrations reduced proliferation and increased apoptosis in the two cell lines. Conclusion Lower baseline erythrocyte folate was associated with adverse CIN1 outcomes after adjustment for the covariates included in the reported model. Event-time assumptions and residual confounding limit interpretation. These findings do not establish causality, an interaction with HR-HPV, or a therapeutic benefit of folate supplementation. Prognostic use requires further validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association between baseline erythrocyte folate levels and the outcomes of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 1 (CIN1) in a community-based prospective cohort of 564 Chinese women. Baseline folate was measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, and follow-up assessments were conducted at 6, 12, and 24 months. title_zh: 前瞻性 队列研究 中的基线红细胞叶酸和低度宫颈上皮内瘤变的结果
source_body_en: Objective To examine the association between baseline erythrocyte folate and reversal, persistence, and progression of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 1 (CIN1). Methods This community-based prospective cohort included 564 Chinese women with CIN1, with follow-up assessments at 6, 12, and 24 months. Baseline erythrocyte folate was measured by chemiluminescence immunoassay. Histological outcomes were classified as reversal, persistence, or progression to CIN2 or worse (CIN2+); persistence and progression formed a composite adverse outcome. Analyses included Cox regression, restricted cubic splines, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves. Exploratory experiments assessed proliferation and apoptosis in C33A and CaSki cervical cancer cells. Results Among the 453 women assessed at 24 months, 342 (75.5%) had reversal, 58 (12.8%) had persistence, and 53 (11.7%) had progression to CIN2+. Lower baseline erythrocyte folate was associated with the composite adverse outcome in the reported adjusted model (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] = 2.42, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.62–3.61). No statistically significant nonlinearity was detected for this outcome at 6 or 12 months ( p = 0.655 and p = 0.127), whereas an L-shaped association was observed at 24 months (P for nonlinearity = 0.005). At 24 months, the area under the ROC curve (AUC) for folate was 0.703 (95% CI: 0.647–0.760) overall and 0.742 (95% CI: 0.646–0.837) within the high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV)-positive subgroup. Higher nominal folate concentrations reduced proliferation and increased apoptosis in the two cell lines. Conclusion Lower baseline erythrocyte folate was associated with adverse CIN1 outcomes after adjustment for the covariates included in the reported model. Event-time assumptions and residual confounding limit interpretation. These findings do not establish causality, an interaction with HR-HPV, or a therapeutic benefit of folate supplementation. Prognostic use requires further validation.

title: Prevalence and risk factors for human papillomavirus infection among women living with HIV in Sierra Leone: A cross-sectional study
abstract: Abstract BackgroundCervical cancer, a malignancy affecting the cervix, is the fourth most common cancer and cause of cancer-related mortality among women worldwide. This burden disproportionately affects low-resource regions, where approximately 90% of cases occur. HIV-positive women are at high risk of persistent Human Papillomavirus (HPV) infection and cervical cancer, but screening for this cancer is not yet integrated into HIV care in Sierra Leone. This study aimed to assess the prevalence and risk factors of high-risk HPV infection among women living with HIV (WLHIV) attending Connaught Hospital in Sierra Leone. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional study of women living with HIV aged 25-65 years attending the HIV clinic at Connaught Teaching Hospital in Freetown between September and December 2024. Endocervical swabs were collected for HPV DNA testing. Data was analyzed using R (v4.4.0). Logistic regression analysis was used to determine the independent risk factors for HPV positivity. Results A total of 191 WLHIV were enrolled. The mean age was 36.8 years; 44.5% were single, and 67% were employed. High-risk HPV DNA was detected in 60 (31.4%) (95% CI 25.3%-38.3%) participants, with 50% (30/60) having multiple serotypes. The most common genotype was HPV 52, followed by 16 and 51. Only 30% of HPV-positive women had genotypes 16 or 18, targeted by the bivalent vaccine. On multivariable analysis, former contraceptive use was independently associated with increased HPV positivity (aOR=4.86, 95% CI: 1.65-17.37, p = 0.0032). Conclusion The high prevalence of high-risk HPV infection and predominance of non 16/18 genotypes among WLHIV in Sierra Leone underscore the need to integrate HPV screening within HIV services and consider broader HPV vaccine coverage in Sierra Leone. Former contraceptive use is an independent predictor of HPV positivity, emphasizing the need for robust screening strategies in women using contraceptives.

title: Mutational Profile of Oropharyngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma in Relation to HPV : Comparison of Taiwan Data With Published Studies
abstract: ABSTRACT Background To descriptively compare genomic profiles by human papillomavirus (HPV) status in a Taiwanese multicenter registry with published Western cohorts. Methods We reviewed aggregate findings from 290 OPSCC cases in TCOG T1322 (ACTOnco + 440‐gene panel) and selected studies from the United States and Europe. No formal cross‐cohort statistical comparison was performed. Results and Discussion Major driver‐gene patterns were broadly similar across cohorts. In the T1322 TMB‐evaluable subset (HPV‐positive n = 187; HPV‐negative n = 99), the supplied summary reported a median TMB of 3.2 mutations/Mb in both groups, with interquartile ranges of 1.3–5.7 and 1.9–4.4 mutations/Mb, respectively. A verified p value for this updated subset was unavailable; therefore, no inference about statistical significance is made. Conclusion Cross‐study patterns are hypothesis‐generating, and quantitative biomarker comparisons require harmonized methodology and independent validation.

title_zh: 与 HPV 相关的口咽鳞状细胞癌的突变特征:台湾数据与已发表研究的比较
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background To descriptively compare genomic profiles by human papillomavirus (HPV) status in a Taiwanese multicenter registry with published Western cohorts. Methods We reviewed aggregate findings from 290 OPSCC cases in TCOG T1322 (ACTOnco + 440‐gene panel) and selected studies from the United States and Europe. No formal cross‐cohort statistical comparison was performed. Results and Discussion Major driver‐gene patterns were broadly similar across cohorts. In the T1322 TMB‐evaluable subset (HPV‐positive n = 187; HPV‐negative n = 99), the supplied summary reported a median TMB of 3.2 mutations/Mb in both groups, with interquartile ranges of 1.3–5.7 and 1.9–4.4 mutations/Mb, respectively. A verified p value for this updated subset was unavailable; therefore, no inference about statistical significance is made. Conclusion Cross‐study patterns are hypothesis‐generating, and quantitative biomarker comparisons require harmonized methodology and independent validation.

title: Longitudinal methylation analysis for risk stratification of CIN2 lesions by HPV genotype
abstract: Abstract Introduction There is an urgent need for biomarkers that can distinguish regressive from progressive cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) lesions to improve risk stratification in cervical cancer screening programs and avoid overtreatment. We aimed to evaluate the longitudinal performance of the S5 methylation classifier in predicting the clinical trajectory of untreated CIN grade 2 (CIN2) across different HPV genotype groups. Material and Methods This study included 122 women (aged 18–30) with histologically confirmed CIN2 enrolled in an active surveillance trial at Helsinki University Hospital, Finland (ISRCTN91953024). Patients were monitored every 6 months for up to 24 months with cytology, HPV genotyping, and colposcopy. S5 methylation levels (pyrosequencing) were compared between women who regressed to normal histology ( n = 89) and those who progressed to CIN3+ ( n = 22, including one microinvasive cancer) or had persistent CIN2 ( n = 11). Analysis was stratified based on baseline HPV genotypes. Results The baseline S5 classifier significantly predicted progression/persistence with an odds ratio (OR) of 1.15 (95%CI 1.05–1.25). When excluding HPV16/18, the S5 classifier demonstrated a similar, borderline predictive association (OR 1.19; 95%CI 1.00–1.41), whereas cytology and HPV genotyping did not. Longitudinal analysis showed that S5 methylation levels in progressors remained elevated throughout the 24‐month period, significantly predicting progression/persistence up to 18 months prior to histological diagnosis of progression. Conclusions In this active surveillance cohort, the S5 classifier showed potential as a prognostic triage biomarker for identifying progression in untreated CIN2, including cases with non‐HPV16/18 types. Our exploratory findings suggest that elevated methylation levels may precede histological progression by up to 18 months. As HPV16/18 prevalence declines, host‐viral methylation panels may offer improved risk stratification compared to standard triage, though larger prospective studies in vaccinated populations are needed to confirm these findings and establish clinical utility.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究纳入了 122 名经组织学证实患有 CIN2 的女性(18-30 岁),他们参加了芬兰赫尔辛基大学医院正在进行的 监测 试验 (ISRCTN91953024)。每 6 个月对患者进行一次细胞学检查、HPV 基因分型和阴道镜检查,持续长达 24 个月。
elements_zh.methods: 比较了组织学恢复正常的女性 (n = 89) 和进展为 CIN3+ 的女性 (n = 22,包括一种微浸润癌) 或持续性 CIN2 (n = 11) 的女性之间的 S5 甲基化水平(焦磷酸测序)。根据基线 HPV 基因型对分析进行分层。
elements_zh.main_results: 基线 S5 分类器显着预测进展/持续性,比值比 (OR) 为 1.15 (95%CI 1.05–1.25)。当排除 HPV16/18 时,S5 分类器表现出类似的边缘预测关联(OR 1.19;95% CI 1.00–1.41),而细胞学和 HPV 基因分型却没有。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们的探索性发现表明,甲基化水平升高可能会先于组织学进展长达 18 个月。

title_zh: 按 HPV 基因型进行 CIN2 病变风险分层的纵向甲基化分析
source_body_en: Abstract Introduction There is an urgent need for biomarkers that can distinguish regressive from progressive cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) lesions to improve risk stratification in cervical cancer screening programs and avoid overtreatment. We aimed to evaluate the longitudinal performance of the S5 methylation classifier in predicting the clinical trajectory of untreated CIN grade 2 (CIN2) across different HPV genotype groups. Material and Methods This study included 122 women (aged 18–30) with histologically confirmed CIN2 enrolled in an active surveillance trial at Helsinki University Hospital, Finland (ISRCTN91953024). Patients were monitored every 6 months for up to 24 months with cytology, HPV genotyping, and colposcopy. S5 methylation levels (pyrosequencing) were compared between women who regressed to normal histology ( n = 89) and those who progressed to CIN3+ ( n = 22, including one microinvasive cancer) or had persistent CIN2 ( n = 11). Analysis was stratified based on baseline HPV genotypes. Results The baseline S5 classifier significantly predicted progression/persistence with an odds ratio (OR) of 1.15 (95%CI 1.05–1.25). When excluding HPV16/18, the S5 classifier demonstrated a similar, borderline predictive association (OR 1.19; 95%CI 1.00–1.41), whereas cytology and HPV genotyping did not. Longitudinal analysis showed that S5 methylation levels in progressors remained elevated throughout the 24‐month period, significantly predicting progression/persistence up to 18 months prior to histological diagnosis of progression. Conclusions In this active surveillance cohort, the S5 classifier showed potential as a prognostic triage biomarker for identifying progression in untreated CIN2, including cases with non‐HPV16/18 types. Our exploratory findings suggest that elevated methylation levels may precede histological progression by up to 18 months. As HPV16/18 prevalence declines, host‐viral methylation panels may offer improved risk stratification compared to standard triage, though larger prospective studies in vaccinated populations are needed to confirm these findings and establish clinical utility.
abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 迫切需要能够区分退行性宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN) 病变和进行性宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN) 病变的生物标志物,以改善 宫颈癌 筛查计划中的风险分层并避免过度治疗。我们的目的是评估 S5 甲基化分类器在预测不同 HPV 基因型组中未经治疗的 2 级 CIN (CIN2) 临床轨迹方面的纵向性能。材料和方法 本研究纳入了 122 名经组织学证实患有 CIN2 的女性(18-30 岁),她们参加了芬兰赫尔辛基大学医院正在进行的 监测 试验 (ISRCTN91953024)。每 6 个月对患者进行一次细胞学检查、HPV 基因分型和阴道镜检查,持续长达 24 个月。比较了组织学恢复正常的女性 (n = 89) 和进展为 CIN3+ 的女性 (n = 22,包括一种微浸润癌) 或持续性 CIN2 (n = 11) 的女性的 S5 甲基化水平(焦磷酸测序)。根据基线 HPV 基因型对分析进行分层。结果 基线 S5 分类器显着预测进展/持续性,比值比 (OR) 为 1.15 (95%CI 1.05–1.25)。当排除 HPV16/18 时,S5 分类器表现出类似的边缘预测关联(OR 1.19;95% CI 1.00–1.41),而细胞学和 HPV 基因分型却没有。纵向分析显示,进展者中的 S5 甲基化水平在整个 24 个月期间保持升高,显着预测了在组织学 诊断 进展之前长达 18 个月的进展/持续性。结论 在这个活跃的 监测 队列研究 中,S5 分类器显示出作为预后分类生物标志物的潜力,用于识别未经治疗的 CIN2 的进展,包括非 HPV16/18 类型的病例。我们的探索性发现表明,甲基化水平升高可能会先于组织学进展长达 18 个月。随着 HPV16/18 患病率 的下降,与标准分类相比,宿主 病毒甲基化组合可能会提供改进的风险分层,尽管需要在疫苗接种人群中进行更大规模的前瞻性研究来证实这些发现并建立临床实用性。

title: Association of Cannabis Use and Risks of Oral Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Oral cancer is a major health concern globally, with its etiology linked to factors such as tobacco use, alcohol consumption, and HPV infection. With changing lifestyle behaviors and the increased legalization of cannabis, its potential role in oral carcinogenesis has garnered attention. This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to evaluate the association between cannabis use and the risk of developing oral cancer. METHODS: A systematic search was conducted across PubMed, EMBASE, and Web of Science to identify studies up to August 15, 2025. Inclusion criteria encompassed adult participants and observational studies on cannabis use and oral cancer risk. Meta-analysis utilized random-effects models to compute pooled odds ratios (ORs) in R software version 4.4. Newcastle Ottawa scale was used for quality assessment. RESULTS: From 1,063 records, 11 studies met the inclusion criteria with a total sample size of 245,594 participants. The meta-analysis revealed a pooled OR of 0.481 (95% CI: 0.306 to 0.757), suggesting a potential reduced risk of oral cancer with cannabis use, particularly noted in case-control studies (pooled OR: 0.455, 95% CI: 0.291 to 0.713). However, cohort study showed no significant association (pooled OR: 2.51, 95% CI: 0.244 to 25.823), and high heterogeneity was observed across studies. CONCLUSION: Current evidence does not support cannabis use as an independent risk factor for oral cancer. Although some case-control studies suggested an inverse association, this finding was not supported by cohort studies and should be interpreted cautiously given the substantial heterogeneity and potential for residual confounding. Further prospective studies are needed to clarify this relationship.

title: Health Economic Impact and Cost Threshold for Switching From Bivalent to Nonavalent HPV Vaccination for Preadolescent Girls in KwaZulu Natal, South Africa: A Mathematical Modeling Analysis Accounting for the HIV Epidemic
abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus bivalent (2vHPV) and nonavalent (9vHPV) vaccines protect against HPV types causing 70% and 90% of cervical cancers, respectively. South African guidelines recommend vaccinating girls ages 9–14 with 1 dose of 2vHPV. Switching recommendations to 9vHPV could avert more cervical cancer burden, but the cost-effectiveness and cost-threshold of 9vHPV in South Africa is unknown. Methods: Using a validated compartmental HPV and HIV transmission model parameterized to KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, we simulated scenarios of 2vHPV and 9vHPV implementation over 100 years with 2 doses (72% coverage) and 1 dose (80% and 90% coverage) with lifelong or waning single-dose vaccine efficacy. We evaluated cervical cancer cases and deaths averted. We also estimated the maximum cost/dose for 9vHPV to be cost-effective using willingness-to-pay thresholds from $500/disability-adjusted life-year (DALY) averted to $3015/DALY averted (2023 USD). We also assessed the incremental cost-effectiveness ratios of 9vHPV at current costs ($110/dose) compared with 2vHPV ($9.23/dose). Results: Single-dose 9vHPV at 80% coverage could avert 7.9% more cervical cancer cases and 6.4% more deaths than 2vHPV (lifelong efficacy). The maximum 9vHPV price to be cost-effective (lifelong efficacy, 80% coverage) ranged from $15 ($500/DALY averted threshold) to $45/dose ($3015/DALY averted threshold). At current market costs, single-dose 9vHPV at 90% coverage exceeds commonly used cost-effective thresholds with incremental cost-effectiveness ratios of $10,480/DALY averted (lifelong efficacy) and $8806/DALY averted (waning efficacy). Conclusions: Implementing 9vHPV can result in a greater reduction in cervical cancer burden than 2vHPV, but vaccine costs need to be reduced for 9vHPV to be cost-effective in KwaZulu-Natal.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the potential health economic impact of switching from bivalent to nonavalent HPV vaccination for preadolescent girls in KwaZulu Natal, South Africa, and to determine the cost threshold for such a switch.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A mathematical modeling analysis was conducted using a validated compartmental HPV and HIV transmission model parameterized to KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, simulating scenarios of 2vHPV and 9vHPV implementation over 100 years with varying coverage rates and vaccine efficacy assumptions.
analysis_en.methods: The study used a compartmental HPV and HIV transmission model parameterized to KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, to simulate the implementation of 2vHPV and 9vHPV over 100 years with different coverage rates and vaccine efficacy assumptions, including lifelong or waning single-dose efficacy.
analysis_en.main_results: Single-dose 9vHPV at 80% coverage could avert 7.9% more cervical cancer cases and 6.4% more deaths than 2vHPV (lifelong efficacy). The maximum 9vHPV price to be cost-effective ranged from $15 to $45/dose, depending on the willingness-to-pay threshold. At current market costs, single-dose 9vHPV at 90% coverage exceeded commonly used cost-effective thresholds with incremental cost-effectiveness ratios of $10,480/DALY averted (lifelong efficacy) and $8806/DALY averted (waning efficacy).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that implementing 9vHPV could result in a greater reduction in cervical cancer burden than 2vHPV, but they emphasized that vaccine costs need to be reduced for 9vHPV to be cost-effective in KwaZulu-Natal.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health decision-making regarding HPV vaccination strategies in South Africa, particularly in considering cost-effectiveness and the potential benefits of switching to 9vHPV.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a mathematical model, which may have limitations in capturing real-world complexities, and the evidence is abstract-only, which may affect the strength of the conclusions.

title_zh: 南非夸祖鲁纳塔尔省青春期前女孩从二价 HPV 疫苗接种 转换为非二价 HPV 疫苗接种 的健康经济影响和成本阈值:考虑艾滋病毒流行的数学模型分析
source_body_en: Background: Human papillomavirus bivalent (2vHPV) and nonavalent (9vHPV) vaccines protect against HPV types causing 70% and 90% of cervical cancers, respectively. South African guidelines recommend vaccinating girls ages 9–14 with 1 dose of 2vHPV. Switching recommendations to 9vHPV could avert more cervical cancer burden, but the cost-effectiveness and cost-threshold of 9vHPV in South Africa is unknown. Methods: Using a validated compartmental HPV and HIV transmission model parameterized to KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, we simulated scenarios of 2vHPV and 9vHPV implementation over 100 years with 2 doses (72% coverage) and 1 dose (80% and 90% coverage) with lifelong or waning single-dose vaccine efficacy. We evaluated cervical cancer cases and deaths averted. We also estimated the maximum cost/dose for 9vHPV to be cost-effective using willingness-to-pay thresholds from $500/disability-adjusted life-year (DALY) averted to $3015/DALY averted (2023 USD). We also assessed the incremental cost-effectiveness ratios of 9vHPV at current costs ($110/dose) compared with 2vHPV ($9.23/dose). Results: Single-dose 9vHPV at 80% coverage could avert 7.9% more cervical cancer cases and 6.4% more deaths than 2vHPV (lifelong efficacy). The maximum 9vHPV price to be cost-effective (lifelong efficacy, 80% coverage) ranged from $15 ($500/DALY averted threshold) to $45/dose ($3015/DALY averted threshold). At current market costs, single-dose 9vHPV at 90% coverage exceeds commonly used cost-effective thresholds with incremental cost-effectiveness ratios of $10,480/DALY averted (lifelong efficacy) and $8806/DALY averted (waning efficacy). Conclusions: Implementing 9vHPV can result in a greater reduction in cervical cancer burden than 2vHPV, but vaccine costs need to be reduced for 9vHPV to be cost-effective in KwaZulu-Natal.
abstract_zh: 背景:人乳头瘤病毒 二价 (2vHPV) 和非价 (9vHPV) 疫苗 可预防分别导致 70% 和 90% 宫颈癌 的 HPV 类型。南非指南建议为 9-14 岁的女孩接种 1 剂 2vHPV。将建议改为 9vHPV 可以避免更多的 宫颈癌 负担,但 9vHPV 在南非的成本效益和成本阈值尚不清楚。方法:使用参数化于南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省的经过验证的区室 HPV 和 HIV 传播 模型,我们模拟了 100 年来 2vHPV 和 9vHPV 实施的场景,其中 2 剂(72% 覆盖率)和 1 剂(80% 和 90% 覆盖率)具有终生或减弱的单剂 疫苗 功效。我们评估了 宫颈癌 病例和避免的死亡。我们还使用支付意愿阈值从 500 美元/避免的伤残调整生命年 (DALY) 到 3015 美元/避免的 DALY(2023 美元)估计 9vHPV 的最大成本/剂量具有成本效益。我们还评估了 9vHPV 按当前成本(110 美元/剂)与 2vHPV(9.23 美元/剂)相比的增量成本效益比。结果:单剂 9vHPV 覆盖率达到 80% 时,与 2vHPV 相比,可避免多 7.9% 的 宫颈癌 病例和多 6.4% 的死亡(终身疗效)。具有成本效益的 9vHPV 最高价格(终身疗效,80% 覆盖率)范围从 15 美元(500 美元/DALY 避免阈值)到 45 美元/剂量(3015 美元/DALY 避免阈值)。按照目前的市场成本,覆盖率达 90% 的单剂 9vHPV 超过了常用的成本效益阈值,增量成本效益比为 10,480 美元/避免 DALY(终身功效)和 8806 美元/避免 DALY(功效减弱)。结论:与 2vHPV 相比,实施 9vHPV 可以更大程度地减少 宫颈癌 负担,但需要降低 疫苗 成本,9vHPV 才能在夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省具有成本效益。

title: Barriers and facilitators to HPV vaccination among adult men: A systematic review and qualitative meta-synthesis
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is widespread and a leading cause of preventable cancers, yet HPV vaccination uptake among adult men remains suboptimal. Qualitative evidence on multilevel determinants of men's vaccination decisions and healthcare responses remains limited. This qualitative meta-synthesis aimed to synthesize barriers and facilitators to HPV vaccination among adult men guided by the Social Ecological Model (SEM), and to explore how vaccination-related health needs are reflected in healthcare resources and translated into service utilization using a health service evaluation framework informed by WHO health service concepts. Ten electronic databases, including PubMed, Embase, and PsycINFO, were searched from inception to December 2025 using controlled vocabulary and free-text terms. Ten studies across four countries were included. The evidence base was concentrated among sexual minority men, sex workers, and healthcare-engaged men, with fewer studies among general male populations; six of the ten studies were conducted in the United States, limiting generalizability to adult men more broadly. Thematic synthesis followed Thomas and Harden's approach, with findings organized across five SEM levels. Key barriers included gendered perceptions of HPV, low perceived susceptibility, stigma and disclosure concerns, provider communication failures, economic constraints, and structural access challenges. Facilitators included provider recommendation, supportive relationships, integrated care pathways, and health information access. Health service evaluation identified gaps between needs, resources, and utilization, particularly outside preventive care. These findings highlight that improving HPV vaccination among adult men requires multilevel behavioral strategies alongside healthcare system improvements that better recognize and respond to men's vaccination needs.

title: Pre-implementation assessment of upstream domains on the uptake of HPV self-sampling in safety-net settings: a scoping review.
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) screening can be used as an early detector for cervical cancer. The newly US Food and Drug Administration-approved HPV self-sampling tests can be used by safety net practices in the USA to help mitigate the current screening disparities seen in patients. As patient acceptability and capability have already been established, this scoping review synthesizes the barriers and facilitators of implementing HPV self-sampling from the perspective of safety net providers and leadership, and the upstream factors not yet explored in current research. Following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, a literature search was conducted exploring peer-reviewed publications and grey literature to establish the current landscape of HPV self-sampling. Findings were organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research. From the 57 works included, it was found that safety net practices are capable of implementing HPV self-sampling by utilizing current workflows and team members. However, outer setting guidelines and policies heavily influence the implementation process, likely causing a delay in uptake by safety net practices. Recent guideline endorsements and forthcoming insurance coverage address several of these barriers, making post-approval implementation research in safety net settings an urgent priority.

The review examines the role of safety net providers and leadership in the uptake of HPV self-sampling tests, which are FDA-approved and aimed at mitigating cervical cancer screening disparities.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review followed PRISMA-ScR guidelines to conduct a literature search, including peer-reviewed publications and grey literature. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Post-approval implementation research in safety net settings is an urgent priority, as recent guideline endorsements and insurance coverage are expected to reduce some of the barriers to HPV self-sampling uptake. analysis.summary_en: This scoping review evaluates the implementation of HPV self-sampling in safety net settings, focusing on upstream factors influencing its uptake. The review highlights that while safety net practices can integrate HPV self-sampling into existing workflows, external guidelines and policies significantly impact the process. Recent endorsements and insurance coverage have begun to address some barriers, but further research is needed to fully understand the implementation landscape. The findings emphasize the importance of post-approval research to enhance equitable access to cervical cancer screening in these settings.

elements_en.scope_and_question: This scoping review focuses on the barriers and facilitators of implementing HPV self-sampling in safety net settings, with an emphasis on upstream factors not yet explored in current research. The review examines the role of safety net providers and leadership in the uptake of HPV self-sampling tests, which are FDA-approved and aimed at mitigating cervical cancer screening disparities.
elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review followed PRISMA-ScR guidelines to conduct a literature search, including peer-reviewed publications and grey literature. The findings were organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research to structure the analysis of implementation factors.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review found that safety net practices are capable of implementing HPV self-sampling by utilizing existing workflows and team members. However, external guidelines and policies significantly influence the implementation process, potentially delaying uptake in these settings.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is a lack of comprehensive research on the upstream factors affecting the implementation of HPV self-sampling in safety net settings. Additionally, the review highlights that while recent guideline endorsements and insurance coverage address some barriers, further research is needed to understand the full impact of these changes.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: Post-approval implementation research in safety net settings is an urgent priority, as recent guideline endorsements and insurance coverage are expected to reduce some of the barriers to HPV self-sampling uptake. This research should focus on understanding the specific challenges and facilitators within these settings to improve equitable access to cervical cancer screening.

title_zh: 对安全网环境中 HPV 自我采样情况上游领域的实施前评估:范围界定审查。
source_body_en: Human papillomavirus (HPV) screening can be used as an early detector for cervical cancer. The newly US Food and Drug Administration-approved HPV self-sampling tests can be used by safety net practices in the USA to help mitigate the current screening disparities seen in patients. As patient acceptability and capability have already been established, this scoping review synthesizes the barriers and facilitators of implementing HPV self-sampling from the perspective of safety net providers and leadership, and the upstream factors not yet explored in current research. Following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, a literature search was conducted exploring peer-reviewed publications and grey literature to establish the current landscape of HPV self-sampling. Findings were organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research. From the 57 works included, it was found that safety net practices are capable of implementing HPV self-sampling by utilizing current workflows and team members. However, outer setting guidelines and policies heavily influence the implementation process, likely causing a delay in uptake by safety net practices. Recent guideline endorsements and forthcoming insurance coverage address several of these barriers, making post-approval implementation research in safety net settings an urgent priority.
abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 筛查可用作 宫颈癌 的早期检测器。美国食品和药物管理局新批准的 HPV 自采样检测可供美国的安全网实践使用,以帮助减轻目前患者中出现的筛查差异。由于患者的可接受性和能力已经建立,本次范围审查从安全网提供者和领导层的角度综合了实施 HPV 自我采样的障碍和促进因素,以及当前研究中尚未探讨的上游因素。遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南,进行了文献检索,探索同行评审的出版物和灰色文献,以确定 HPV 自我采样的当前状况。调查结果是使用实施研究综合框架进行组织的。从纳入的 57 项工作中发现,安全网实践能够利用当前的工作流程和团队成员来实施 HPV 自我采样。然而,外部制定的指导方针和政策严重影响实施过程,可能导致安全网实践的延迟。最近的指南认可和即将推出的保险范围解决了其中一些障碍,使安全网设置的批准后实施研究成为当务之急。

title: U.S. state-level variation in caregiver-reported provider recommendation of HPV vaccination to 13-to-17-year-old adolescents
abstract: Abstract Introduction Although regional differences in provider recommendation of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine have been documented, limited research has examined variation at the state level. Therefore, this study examined state-level differences in caregiver-reported health care provider recommendation of HPV vaccines among 13-to-17-year-old adolescents in the United States. Method Using a cross-sectional design to examine data from the National Immunization Survey–Teen (2023), multivariable logistic regression was used to model state-specific variations in provider recommendation of HPV vaccine. Proportion estimation was used to examine state-specific prevalence. Result Provider recommendation varied considerably across states. For example, the odds of reporting a recommendation were lower among caregivers of adolescents in Arkansas (adjusted odds ratio [AOR] = 0.56, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.33 to 0.96), Georgia (AOR = 0.49, 95% CI = 0.26 to 0.93), and Mississippi (AOR = 0.42, 95% CI = 0.24 to 0.74), and higher among caregivers in New Hampshire (AOR = 2.40, 95% CI = 1.23 to 4.68) compared with adolescents in California. Greater heterogeneity was observed in the South compared with other regions. For example, the prevalence of not receiving a recommendation was 16% in Maryland and 41% in Mississippi. Conclusion The findings underscore the need to improve HPV vaccine recommendation in some states in the United States. In particular, states with low rates should be targeted for focused interventions.

title: Colposcopic magnified scanning-assisted CO 2 laser treatment (CMSLT) for vaginal high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (VaHSIL): A single-center prospective cohort study.
abstract: To evaluate the feasibility of Colposcopic Magnified Scanning Laser Treatments (CMSLT), divided into laser excision (CMSLE) and vaporization (CMSLV), using a scanner-assisted CO 2 laser as a singular outpatient therapeutic modality for patients affected by vaginal high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (vaHSIL). vaginal high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (vaHSIL) is a rare condition associated with persistent high-risk HPV infection, carrying a concrete potential for progression into invasive carcinoma. Due to diagnostic complexities and the rarity of the disease, its optimal clinical management and treatment standardization remain controversial. This prospective non-randomized cohort study was conducted between January 2022 and June 2024 on 63 patients with histologically confirmed vaHSIL. Based on the 2011 IFCPC colposcopic terminology, patients were assigned to either the CMSLV group (n = 22) or the CMSLE group (n = 41). The outpatient protocol utilized a laser system implemented with a computerized surgical scanner-assisted micromanipulator. The two-year follow-up included semi-annual screenings with HPV testing, cytology, and colposcopy. Follow-up adherence was high, with a dropout rate limited to 11.3%. The cumulative recurrence risk for vaHSIL was 14.5%, with no statistically significant difference between the two modalities, although the CMSLE group showed a higher 2-year disease-free survival rate (70% vs. The progression rate to invasive carcinoma was 1.6% 1 cases in the CMSLE cohort), revealing a 2.4% rate of occult cancer missed at initial colposcopic assignment. Only one major complication occurred (vaginal perforation, 1.6% in a post-hysterectomy patient), with no minor complications or long-term sequelae (dyspareunia or pain) reported. CMSLT may represent feasible approach since it happened to be safe, effective and associated with patient compliance. The precision of the scanner-assisted technology minimizes thermal damage and the risk of undertreating occult cancer, allowing for tailored and efficient therapy.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估阴道镜放大扫描激光 治疗 (CMSLT) 对于阴道高级鳞状上皮内病变 (vaHSIL) 患者的可行性,这是一种与持续性 高危型HPV 感染和潜在进展为浸润性癌相关的罕见疾病。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2022 年 1 月至 2024 年 6 月期间,对 63 名经组织学证实患有 vaHSIL 的患者进行了一项单中心前瞻性非随机 队列研究 研究。根据 2011 年 IFCPC 阴道镜术语,患者被分配到 CMSLV 组 (n = 22) 或 CMSLE 组 (n = 41)。
elements_zh.methods: 门诊方案使用了由计算机手术扫描仪辅助显微操作器实现的激光系统。为期两年的随访包括每半年进行一次 HPV 检测、细胞学检查和阴道镜检查。
elements_zh.main_results: vaHSIL 的累积复发风险为 14.5%,两种治疗方式之间无统计学差异。CMSLE 组显示出较高的 2 年无病生存率(70%,而侵袭性癌进展率为 1.6%(CMSLE 队列研究 中的 1 例)),表明初始阴道镜分配时隐匿性癌症的漏诊率为 2.4%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明 CMSLT 可能是一种可行的方法,因为它安全、有效,并且与患者的依从性相关。扫描仪辅助技术的精度可最大限度地减少热损伤和隐匿性癌症治疗不足的风险,从而实现量身定制的高效治疗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果可能为 vaHSIL 标准化 治疗 方案的开发提供信息,特别是在 HPV 相关疾病的背景下,通过强调扫描仪辅助激光 治疗 在提高无病生存率和降低隐匿性癌症风险方面的潜在益处。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是非随机的,可能会引入偏差,并且随访期仅限于两年。由于研究设计和样本量相对较小,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 评估阴道镜放大扫描激光 治疗 (CMSLT) 的可行性,分为激光切除 (CMSLE) 和汽化 (CMSLV),使用扫描仪辅助 CO 2 激光作为阴道高级鳞状上皮内病变 (vaHSIL) 患者的单一门诊治疗方式。阴道高级鳞状上皮内病变 (vaHSIL) 是一种与持续性 高危型HPV 感染相关的罕见疾病,具有进展为浸润性癌的具体潜力。由于诊断的复杂性和疾病的罕见性,其最佳临床管理和 治疗 标准化仍存在争议。这项前瞻性非随机 队列研究 研究于 2022 年 1 月至 2024 年 6 月期间对 63 名经组织学证实患有 vaHSIL 的患者进行。根据 2011 年 IFCPC 阴道镜术语,患者被分配到 CMSLV 组 (n = 22) 或 CMSLE 组 (n = 41)。门诊方案使用了由计算机手术扫描仪辅助显微操作器实现的激光系统。为期两年的随访包括每半年进行一次 HPV 检测、细胞学检查和阴道镜检查。随访依从性很高,脱落率限制在 11.3%。vaHSIL 的累积复发风险为 14.5%,两种治疗方式之间没有统计学上的显着差异,尽管 CMSLE 组显示出较高的 2 年无病生存率(CMSLE 队列研究 组的 2 年无病生存率为 70%,而 CMSLE 队列研究 组的浸润性癌进展率为 1.6%),表明初始阴道镜分配时隐匿性癌症的漏诊率为 2.4%。仅发生一种主要并发症(阴道穿孔,子宫切除术后患者的发生率为 1.6%),没有报告轻微并发症或长期后遗症(性交困难或疼痛)。CMSLT 可能代表了可行的方法,因为它恰好是安全、有效的并且与患者的依从性相关。扫描仪辅助技术的精度可最大限度地减少热损伤和隐匿性癌症治疗不足的风险,从而实现量身定制的高效治疗。

title: Multimodal Deep Learning Prognostic Model for Predicting Treatment Outcomes for Oropharyngeal Carcinoma.
abstract: PURPOSE: Accurate prediction of locoregional recurrence (LRR) in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) is needed to guide treatment de-escalation decisions, but validated prognostic models integrating imaging and clinical data are lacking. We developed and evaluated a multimodal deep learning model combining pretreatment computed tomography (CT) with clinical variables to predict LRR. METHODS: In this retrospective multicenter prognostic study, we assembled 1,384 patients with histologically confirmed OPSCC treated with definitive radiotherapy with or without concurrent chemotherapy and without surgical resection of the primary tumor. Data were drawn from 1 private institutional archive and five publicly available archives. A cross-attention model fusing CT and clinical features was compared with feature concatenation, clinical-only, and imaging-only models. The primary outcome was LRR. Discrimination was assessed by Harrell Concordance Index (C-index) across 3-fold cross-validation, and risk stratification by Kaplan-Meier analysis with log-rank testing. Attribution analysis was used to identify influential predictors. RESULTS: LRR occurred in 161 of 1,384 patients (11.6%) over a median follow-up of 59.8 months (interquartile range, 25.8-89.0 months). The cross-attention model achieved the highest mean C-index, 0.718 (range, 0.699-0.734), followed by the clinical-only (0.705; range, 0.680-0.735), feature concatenation (0.697; range, 0.673-0.721), and imaging-only (0.674; range, 0.666-0.680) models. High-risk patients had significantly shorter LRR-free survival than low-risk patients in all three folds (log-rank P < .001 for each). Smoking history and human papillomavirus status were the most influential clinical predictors. CONCLUSION: A multimodal cross-attention deep learning model integrating CT with clinical variables showed numerically better discrimination for LRR prediction in OPSCC than unimodal approaches. Prospective external validation is required before such models inform individualized treatment decisions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 需要准确预测口咽鳞状细胞癌 (OPSCC) 的局部区域复发 (LRR) 来指导 治疗 降级决策,但缺乏整合影像和临床数据的经过验证的预后模型。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项回顾性多中心预后研究中,我们汇集了 1,384 名经组织学证实的 OPSCC 患者,接受根治性放疗,伴或不伴同步化疗,且未手术切除原发肿瘤。
elements_zh.methods: 数据取自 1 个私人机构档案馆和 5 个公开档案馆。主要结局是LRR。通过 3 倍交叉验证的 Harrell 一致性指数(C 指数)评估歧视,并通过 Kaplan-Meier 分析和对数秩检验进行风险分层。归因分析用于识别有影响力的预测因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 中位随访时间为 59.8 个月(四分位数范围,25.8-89.0 个月),1,384 名患者中有 161 名 (11.6%) 发生 LRR。交叉注意力模型实现了最高的平均 C 指数,0.718(范围,0.699-0.734),其次是仅临床模型(0.705;范围,0.680-0.735)、特征串联模型(0.697;范围,0.673-0.721)和仅成像模型(0.674;范围,0.666-0.680)型号。在所有三个方面,高风险患者的无 LRR 生存期均显着短于低风险患者(每个对数秩 P < .001)。吸烟史和 人乳头瘤病毒 状态是最有影响力的临床预测因素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 将 CT 与临床变量相结合的多模态交叉注意力深度学习模型在 OPSCC 中的 LRR 预测方面显示出比单模态方法更好的数值辨别力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果可能通过提高 LRR 预测的准确性,为 HPV 相关口咽癌患者的个体化 治疗 决策提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 在此类模型告知个性化 治疗 决策之前,需要进行前瞻性外部验证。
